thread:
support_maria: Heads-up — multiple customers reporting 504/gateway timeouts for hosted/text-generation around 10:08 UTC. Spike correlated with a tenant burst. Filing here for triage.

sre_alex: can you paste a sample request id or tenant id?

support_maria: tenant=acme-marketing, sample request_id=req_0a9f3b. Errors in support logs: 504 gateway, backend 5xx after 10s. Customers say it lasts ~4-8m.

eng_sam: logs from proxy show backend connections closed with ECONNRESET, also seeing long queue depth on worker queue: backlog ~1200 requests for that tenant at peak.

oncall_julie: metrics: HPA target CPU barely increased; KEDA ScaledObject not creating new replicas fast enough — scaling events show backoff. ScaledObject annotations set pollInterval=30s and cooldownPeriod=300s.

sre_alex: interesting. KEDA pollInterval 30s + cooldown 300s is aggressive for high-burst tenants. That could explain slow reaction.

support_maria: customers also reported intermittent auth failures earlier (403) when fetching model weights from model-store, then fallback succeeded. Possibly transient auth token rotation + billing hiccup.

billing_bob: we rotated the storage service principal at 09:58 UTC for billing isolation for a tenant cohort; rotation TTL was 2m but rollout overlapped with burst traffic. Possibility of short-lived 403s.

eng_sam: reproduction steps I'm running locally to mimic: 1) flood tenant with 100 concurrent sessions, 2) ensure cache miss by clearing prefix cache, 3) track scale events. Observed slow replica creation due to image pull delays because nodes hit registry rate limits.

oncall_julie: can you share KEDA ScaledObject events (kubectl get events)?

eng_sam: paste: ```
Events:
  Normal  SuccessfulGetDatapoints  scaledobject/my-tenant  ScaledObject detected 600 datapoints
  Warning BackoffScaling           scaledobject/my-tenant  backoff: waiting for cooldown
  Normal  ScaleUp                  hpa/my-deployment         Scaled up to 2
  Warning CreatePodFailed         pod/my-deployment-7abc    Failed to pull image: throttled by registry
``` 

sre_alex: registry throttle + cooldown + probe/warmup delays = perfect storm. Also readiness probe is set to initialDelay=5s, period=10s, but model init (cold) can take 40s. Pods are marked not ready and HPA/KEDA decisions oscillate.

support_maria: customers saw errors like: ```{"error":"backend_init_timeout","msg":"model init timed out after 15s"}``` Looks like our frontend cutoff for model init is too short and leads to gateway 504s.

eng_sam: suggested quick mitigations: - increase KEDA pollInterval to 5s for high-tier tenants (fast reaction) - reduce cooldown to 60s - prewarm policy: create 1 spare replica during predicted bursts - increase frontend init timeout to 60s while we stabilize

oncall_julie: also recommend changing readiness probe to initialDelaySeconds=60 and periodSeconds=5 for model-serving pods; otherwise kube marks pods NotReady and they never receive traffic to finish init.

billing_bob: rolling back the storage principal rotation reverted the 403s within ~90s. We'll add a maintenance window next time.

deploy-bot: deployment/redwood-model-worker rolling update started by eng_sam @ 10:42 UTC

eng_sam: rolling patch applied: ScaledObject annotations: pollInterval=5s, cooldownPeriod=60s; also bumped prewarm replica count for acme-marketing. Frontend timeout increased to 60s.

sre_alex: post-patch metrics: queue depth dropped from 1200 -> 50 within 90s, 504s subsided. No more image pull throttle after we increased registry parallelism and added local caching nodes.

support_maria: relaying to customers: latency spike root causes: (1) short model-init timeouts, (2) KEDA cooldown + pollInterval too high for sudden tenant bursts, (3) transient model-store auth rotation causing 403s and cache misses, (4) registry pull throttling increasing pod start time. Apologized and offered credits.

oncall_julie: follow-ups: create runbook checklist: - ensure prewarm for VIP tenants - tuned KEDA defaults (pollInterval=5s, cooldown=60s) in prod helm chart - enforce maintenance windows for storage auth rotations - add registry caching nodes and increase imagePullParallelism - extend frontend init timeout to 60s and adjust readiness probe

support_maria: customers confirmed recovery and are monitoring. Closing thread unless someone wants to keep open for infra changes.

sre_alex: I'll convert the notes into a post-incident doc and assign action items. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
